source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the Allocation Order step (rule 05.03) begins for attacks with at least one **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** weapon, if an attacking model can see a **CHARACTER** model in the target unit, the active player can pick an allocation group holding such a **CHARACTER** model. If they do, that group becomes the current allocation group until the attacks end or that group is destroyed, whichever comes first.

interpretation.question: Where does allocation continue after the chosen CHARACTER group is destroyed?

detail.appliesTo: attacks made with one or more [PRECISION] weapons

effect.select: one allocation group containing one of those visible CHARACTER models

afterSelectedGroupDestroyed.remainingAttacks: allocated in the normal allocation order
afterSelectedGroupDestroyed.startFrom: first group that still has models

chooserRule.meaning: controlling player of the unit selected to shoot or fight, until those attacks are resolved
